source.method: Complete HTML semantic text extraction; chapter-boundary map retains original section IDs.

scope: Complete canonical HTML extraction and section inventory; editorial reading focused on introduction, argument sequence, selected substantive claim passages, limitations and conclusion. No claim to independent bibliography verification or word-by-word proofreading of the whole book.
imageDecision: Source covers and diagrams visually inspected in source-image-contact.png. Covers omitted to keep original visual identity. Relevant relationships are simplified and redrawn as original vector compositions; no raster or tiny source labels embedded. Source diagram arrows are conceptual dependency relations, not numerical measurements.
provenanceRule: Source IDs use extraction IDs, not chapter indices; exact substantive body spans retained per scene.
